title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)

Location: Brazil

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.

Position Overview

As a Backend Team Lead, you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.

Competencies / Requirements

  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.

Competencies / Requirements

  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: ANALISTA PROCESSOS REGULATORIOS JR
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nós somos a Cogna, a maior e mais completa empresa de serviços educacionais do país.

Com quase 60 anos de história e mais de 60 marcas, atuamos de forma ampla e integrada, com soluções para escolas, governos e estudantes dos 2 aos 100 anos.

Entre nossas marcas estão Anglo, Red Balloon e Anhanguera, além das editoras Ática, Saraiva, Scipione, que refletem a diversidade e a força do nosso ecossistema educacional.

Contamos com mais de 26 mil colaboradores e o nosso propósito é claro: oferecer soluções educacionais que impulsionam pessoas e organizações a construírem uma melhor versão de si.

Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Processos Regulatórios Jr. para atuar no suporte às rotinas de monitoramento regulatório e organização de informações estratégicas da companhia. A pessoa será responsável por apoiar o controle e atualização de dados, garantindo conformidade e visibilidade dos processos regulatórios para a gestão.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Realizar o monitoramento e atualização de controles em Excel, garantindo a organização e confiabilidade das informações.

• Apoiar na gestão e manutenção de aplicações em Power Apps utilizadas pela área.

• Atualizar e alimentar painéis e relatórios de indicadores, assegurando a visibilidade dos processos regulatórios.

• Acompanhar e registrar novas portarias, normas e legislações, mantendo as bases de dados atualizadas.

• Dar suporte técnico e operacional ao time, auxiliando na interpretação de informações regulatórias e organização de documentos.

• Contribuir para a organização de dados e informações sensíveis, garantindo precisão, segurança e rastreabilidade.

• Apoiar na preparação de documentações e materiais para auditorias, diligências ou visitas regulatórias.

• Eventualmente, poderá participar de viagens para suporte em atividades da área.

Requisitos e qualificações

• Organização e atenção a detalhes no tratamento de dados e informações.

• Conhecimento ou familiaridade com Excel (controles e bases de dados).

• Experiência ou interesse em Power Apps e gestão de indicadores/painéis será considerado um diferencial.

• Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo.

Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: SR Desenvolvimento React Native + IA
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7o ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília

Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor React Native que não apenas construa interfaces, mas que entenda como integrar Inteligência Artificial no core do produto. O candidato ideal é um engenheiro \"AI-First\", que utiliza ferramentas como Cursor para acelerar o desenvolvimento e possui conhecimento profundo sobre como orquestrar Agentes de IA e gerenciar contexto via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Você trabalhará diretamente com Spec-Driven Development (SDD), transformando PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) em especificações técnicas precisas que alimentam fluxos de codificação assistida por IA.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento Mobile: Arquitetar e desenvolver aplicações escaláveis em React Native (iOS/Android) com TypeScript.
  • Integração de IA: Implementar funcionalidades que consomem LLMs, gerenciam estado de conversação e integram ferramentas externas via MCP.
  • Fluxo AI-First: Utilizar o editor Cursor como IDE principal, dominando a composição de contextos, regras de projeto (.cursorrules) e automação de refatoração.
  • Engenharia de Especificação: Atuar no modelo Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Ler o PRD, criar/refinar a Spec técnica e garantir que a implementação siga estritamente o contrato definido, utilizando IA para geração e validação de código.
  • Agentes Autônomos: Desenvolver ou integrar \"Agent Skills\" dentro do app, permitindo que o usuário interaja com agentes capazes de executar tarefas complexas (ex: buscar dados, agendar, analisar).
  • Qualidade: Garantir performance, acessibilidade e testes automatizados, validando o código gerado por IA.

Requisitos

  • React Native: Domínio avançado (Hooks, Performance, Native Modules, Reanimated).
  • TypeScript: Tipagem estrita e avançada.
  • Ecossistema de IA: Experiência prática com Cursor IDE (Composer, Chat, Rules).
  • Conhecimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol) para conexão de dados e ferramentas.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de AI Agents e Orquestração (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK ou similar).
  • Metodologia: Vivência com Spec-Driven Development ou trabalho orientado a contratos de interface/API.
  • Produto: Capacidade de ler e questionar PRDs, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em especificações técnicas.

Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.

Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco

  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.

You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.

This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.

What You'll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
  • Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
  • Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines

If you're a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.

  • Contribuir para soluções digitais modernas, escaláveis e orientadas a dados, dentro de um ambiente global e colaborativo.

O que você precisa ter

  • .NET Core e C#
  • Pelo menos um framework front-end moderno (React, Angular, Vue)
  • Node.js para serviços backend ou full stack com Vue
  • Experiência construindo e consumindo APIs REST.
  • Familiaridade com Azure SQL, Azure Web Apps e práticas de desenvolvimento em nuvem.

  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de secure coding.

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office, com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget. This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments.
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management, DevSecOps, and new collaboration tools) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams, managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation, or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment, managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles, with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure. Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.

Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.

TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.

This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:

\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.

What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.

Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.

Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.

Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.

Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.

What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.

Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

DevOps

  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Linux systems administration
  • Networking fundamentals

Automation

Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.

Languages

Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.

Why work with Quave

We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).

Pay and Benefits

This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

  • Fully remote work
  • Flexible hours
  • 22 days paid time off per year
  • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
  • AI allowance for productivity tools

We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.

Hiring Process

  • Application review
  • Technical conversation
  • Architecture discussion
  • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
  • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S.
-Based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Immigration Attorney (Us-Licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing "Immigration Attorney position”.

title: Engenheiro(A) De Dados Sênior – Oracle Cloud
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos de dados, com foco em arquitetura, integração e processamento de dados na Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em uma arquitetura medallion (Bronze, Prata e Ouro,, integrando fontes heterogêneas — incluindo Oracle Fusion Analytics, APIs, Bancos de Dados e plataformas diversas — garantindo escalabilidade, performance e qualidade das informações utilizadas pelas áreas de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados em ambientes Oracle Cloud, com foco em Oracle Cloud Data Integration e Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).

- Construir e gerenciar integrações de dados via APIs REST e ingestão de arquivos (CSV, JSON, XML, Parquet) a partir de fontes heterogêneas.

- Extrair e harmonizar dados do Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW), consolidando informações financeiras e operacionais no Data Lake.

- Modelar e estruturar dados nas camadas analíticas para suportar soluções de BI e relatórios analíticos em Power BI.

- Trabalhar com processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT) respeitando a arquitetura de camadas do Data Lake.

- Apoiar a construção e manutenção do Catálogo de Dados no OCI, incluindo descoberta, linhagem e glossário.

Requisitos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos sobre Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

- Experiência com OCI Data Integration ou ferramenta equivalente de orquestração e transformação de dados em Oracle Cloud.

- Conhecimento em Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) e Oracle Object Storage.

- Experiência com integração de dados via APIs REST e múltiplas fontes de dados heterogêneas.

- Experiência com SQL avançado e modelagem de dados (dimensional e analítica).

- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).

- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.

- Experiência com linguagens de programação voltadas a dados (Python ou similar).


Diferenciais:

- Experiência com Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) — extração e entendimento do modelo de dados do Fusion.

- Vivência com Oracle Data Catalog para gestão de metadados e linhagem de dados.

- Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) para integração de sistemas.

- Familiaridade com Power BI como camada de consumo dos dados estruturados.


Modelo de Trabalho

- Remoto

- Contratação PJ

- TotalPass

Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us;
you will regularly havean outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.G., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data;
    partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable businessteams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks;
    contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience withETL processes and/or tools (e.G., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience withSiebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Especialista Em Chatbot & Conversão — Curadoria, Otimização E Escala (Whatsapp E Ia)
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ

Remoto

A ConCrédito é uma das maiores correspondentes bancárias do Brasil, especializada em crédito consignado nas modalidades CLT, INSS e FGTS. Com mais de 300 mil clientes atendidos via WhatsApp, a ConCrédito preza pelo bom atendimento e pela experiência do cliente, comprovados pelas mais de 21 mil avaliações positivas no Google Meu Negócio.

O Papel

O Especialista em Chatbot & Conversão será responsável por evoluir a jornada conversacional da empresa no WhatsApp, nosso principal canal de aquisição e conversão. Essa pessoa atuará na otimização contínua da experiência, reduzindo atritos, recuperando leads e aumentando a eficiência do funil por meio de automação, testes e uso de IA.

Responsabilidades

  • Mapear, analisar e otimizar a jornada conversacional de ponta a ponta no WhatsApp, identificando gargalos, fricções e oportunidades de melhoria nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Evoluir a arquitetura dos fluxos conversacionais com foco em experiência, engajamento, recuperação e conversão.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups, segmentações e estrutura de fluxo.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios, campanhas de reengajamento e estratégias de recuperação.
  • Trabalhar na personalização da jornada a partir de clusters de audiência, comportamento e contexto do cliente.
  • Apoiar a construção de dashboards e análises da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados, garantindo visibilidade dos principais indicadores de performance.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com Marketing, Vendas, BI, Operações e Produto/Tech para transformar insights em melhorias concretas na experiência e nos resultados.
  • Contribuir com o uso de IA e automação para escalar conversas com mais eficiência, relevância e capacidade de conversão.

KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em Growth, CRO, Lifecycle, CRM, Produto ou áreas correlatas, com foco em conversão e evolução de jornada.
  • Vivência prática com canais conversacionais, especialmente WhatsApp, automação de mensagens e/ou chatbots.
  • Capacidade de mapear funis, identificar gargalos e transformar análise em ação.
  • Repertório em testes A/B, experimentação e otimização contínua de jornada.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada para acompanhar métricas de funil, cohort, LTV, CAC e performance por etapa.
  • Boa visão de experiência do cliente e comportamento em jornadas digitais.
  • Capacidade técnica para utilizar ou estruturar soluções com IA, agentes e automações aplicadas à conversão.
  • Boa comunicação e influência para atuar com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, crédito, cobrança, serviços financeiros ou operações B2C com alto volume de leads.
  • Vivência com desenho de experiências conversacionais e arquitetura de fluxos.
  • Experiência em produto, CX ou gestão de jornadas digitais.
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Supabase, Metabase, Power BI ou ferramentas similares.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada à personalização, qualificação e conversão em canais conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em automação com N8N.
  • Experiência com plataformas conversacionais como Blip, ColmeIA ou similares.

Essa vaga NÃO é para você se:

  • Você é mais executor do que estrategista e não tem experiência otimizando funis de conversão.
  • Sua experiência está focada em social media, branding ou marketing de conteúdo.
  • Você trabalha apenas com análise de dados, sem transformar insights em ações práticas.
  • Sua atuação em growth é mais teórica do que prática (cursos, conceitos, pouca execução real).
  • Você nunca lidou com alto volume de leads ou operações em escala.
  • Seu foco é apenas aquisição (tráfego pago) e não conversão ao longo da jornada.
  • Você não tem experiência com chatbots, automação de mensagens ou fluxos conversacionais.
  • Você precisa de direcionamento constante e não tem autonomia para testar, iterar e tomar decisões.

title: Consultor De Governança

Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência sólida com Databricks e configuração de Unity Catalog .
  • Conhecimento profundo em SQL e linguagens utilizadas em ambiente de dados (Python ou Scala).

  • Experiência com ferramentas de Catálogo de Dados e Linhagem (Data Lineage).
  • Entendimento de fluxos de MLOps e governança aplicada a modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade excepcional em escrita técnica e documentação.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração para ambientes de governança centralizada.

Perfil Desejado (Soft Skills)

  • Perfil Analítico: Capacidade de organizar grandes volumes de informação de forma lógica.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor com a padronização e qualidade da documentação.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Capacidade de explicar políticas complexas de forma simples para diferentes áreas.

title: Cro & Marketing Specialist (Ux, Content Writing)
description:
Company Description

We are Charly, a growing digital agency specializing in web design, UX/UI, branding, ecommerce, and development for clients primarily in the US. Our team is spread across Europe and Latin America and we are scaling fast.

We are looking for a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist who is passionate about websites, data, and improving performance. This role will focus on analyzing user behavior, identifying conversion bottlenecks, and implementing structured experimentation to improve lead generation and sales performance across our client projects.

You will work closely with our Project Managers, designers, developers, and leadership team to ensure that the websites we build are not only visually strong but also optimized to convert.

Your Core Responsibilities

  • Conduct CRO audits for client websites and landing pages to identify friction points, funnel drop-offs, and conversion barriers
  • Analyze user behavior using tools such as Google Analytics, Tag Manager, heatmaps, and session recordings
  • Identify issues related to checkout abandonment, form drop-offs, mobile UX problems, trust gaps, and messaging clarity
  • Design and implement structured A/B or multivariate experiments to improve conversion performance
  • Optimize key elements including headlines, CTAs, layouts, forms, product pages, and landing pages
  • Prepare structured audit reports with prioritized recommendations based on potential revenue impact
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and PMs to implement CRO improvements across active client projects
  • Join client and sales calls when necessary to explain CRO strategies, findings, and experiment results in clear, non-technical language
  • Continuously refine optimization strategies as new data and experiment results become available

Who this role is perfect for:

  • Someone with strong analytical thinking who can translate data into clear action steps
  • Someone who understands both UX and marketing psychology behind conversions
  • Someone comfortable running experiments and interpreting results
  • Someone who enjoys working with websites, funnels, and digital products
  • Someone proactive who can identify improvement opportunities without waiting for direction
  • Someone comfortable collaborating with designers, developers, and project managers in a remote team environment
  • Someone fluent in English and confident communicating with clients
  • Based in Latin America

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote role in a growing digital agency
  • Flexible work environment with a distributed international team
  • Opportunity to work on multiple websites and client projects across different industries
  • Direct collaboration with leadership, PMs, designers, and developers
  • Long-term role with the opportunity to shape CRO processes as the agency scales

To Apply:

To apply, send your CV and a 1-minute video introducing yourself and your experience to with the subject line:

\ "CRO & Marketing Specialist Application - (Your Full Name)\ "

In your video, briefly cover who you are, your marketing and CRO background, and one result or project you are proud of.

Applications submitted via LinkedIn will NOT be considered. Please ensure you meet the listed qualifications before applying.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services;
our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You'll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You'll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.

What You'll Do

· Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

· Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

· Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

· Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

· Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

· Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

· Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap

Requirements (Must-Haves)

· Fluent English (written and spoken) ;
confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

· 5+ years in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

· Solution engineering capability in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

· You've contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

· Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

· Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

· Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

· Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.G., Salesforce, HubSpot)

· Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

· Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

· Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

· Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

· Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

· Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product

Location & Working Hours

· Brazil-based ( fully remote )

· Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)working hours

What We Offer

· Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

· Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

· Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

· High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

· Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings

How to Apply

Submit your CV in English, and one paragraph describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client's go-live in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Market Intelligence Manager - Americas
description:

Customer development

Customer relationship management

Marketing service:

  • Delivery & after-sales: responsible for leveraging internal capability and external resources to deliver marketing service and after-sales

Main Responsibilities

Although the position is a management role the candidate also expected to be hands on and involved wherever required for the regional team to carry out the following responsibilities:

  • Market Research

To visit customer site with sales and also collect market information in their region such as:

  • Customer Survey Analysis
  • Customer service needs/opportunities
  • Customer's org chart
  • Customer's end consumer insights and trends
  • Prospects and opportunity analysis
  • Category Analysis
  • Sales Channels
  • Competitive landscape
  • Marketing Support Service

Help promote, drive and expand our added value service to our customers to provide them with our 360 marketing solution

  • Market Research/Business Intelligence
  • Receipe support
  • `zSales distribution
  • Account Based Marketing

Will be responsible to perform research to find high-value accounts to target as well as spend time developing growth strategies from their findings. They will ensure marketing activities line up with strategies developed and ultimately translate plans to the sales team for execution. They need to ensure the follow steps are covered:

  • Identify high-value target accounts – Identify key accounts that have the potential to contribute the most to the revenue of your company.
  • Conduct research on those accounts - Get a good snapshot of customer needs and pain points, as well as where they are in their customer journey.
  • Develop customized marketing campaigns - Using information you learned in the research phase to inform your strategy, develop creative assets that will resonate with the target account.
  • Run customized marketing campaigns - Launch your campaigns to the target account.
  • Measure customized marketing campaigns - Analyze the data to see how your campaigns are performing.
  • Online Marketing

Will be in charge of creating localized content regularly update the following marketing channels in their assigned region.

  • Webinars
  • SEO – Quarterly updates on the regional assigned webpage
  • Social media – Weekly updates on social media platforms in where they are based – language will depend on where they are based
  • Email marketing – Monthly articles that can be distributed for sales use in their regions.
  • Offline Marketing

Will handle the planning and implementation of offline marketing tasks in the assigned region which could cover

  • Exhibitions
  • Roadshows
  • Print (Quarterly updates)
  • PowerPoint presentations (Company introductions, products or service introductions)
  • Public Relations
  • Build up media relations and 'Distribution Media List' for future press release distribution in their assigned region.
  • Ensure appearance on at least one reputable news website in their assigned region.

Qualifications (Education/Knowledge/Working Experience)

  • Master's degree in a Marketing related discipline.
  • Around 10 years of experience
  • Knowledgable in hands on B2B2C marketing as well as the consumer market in the beverage industry.

Skills Needed

Market Research and Analysis: The ability to conduct thorough market research, analyze data, and draw actionable insights is crucial for understanding the target market, consumer behavior, and industry trends.

Strategic Planning: Regional Marketing Managers must be adept at developing and executing marketing strategies that align with overall business objectives. This includes setting clear goals, defining KPIs, and creating actionable plans.

Team Leadership and Management: Effective leadership skills are important for managing and motivating a team of marketing professionals. This includes providing guidance, setting expectations, and facilitating collaboration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Regional Marketing Managers need to work closely with various departments like sales, product development, and supply chain to ensure that marketing initiatives are aligned with overall business operations.

Brand Management: They should have the ability to maintain and enhance the brand image in the specified region. This involves ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, and customer experience.

Campaign Management: This skill involves planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns. It requires the ability to set clear objectives, target the right audience, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns.

Budget Management: Effective allocation and management of marketing budgets are essential for maximizing return on investment (ROI) and ensuring that resources are used efficiently.

Data Analysis and Interpretation: Proficiency in using data analytics tools to measure campaign performance, track key metrics, and derive actionable insights is crucial for making informed marketing decisions.

Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary for conveying marketing messages effectively to various stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners.

Adaptability and Flexibility: The ability to adapt to changing market conditions, consumer preferences, and industry trends is vital for staying competitive and achieving long-term success.

Problem-Solving Skills: Regional Marketing Managers should be able to identify challenges and develop creative solutions to overcome them. This includes being resourceful and thinking critically.

Cultural Awareness and Sensitivity: Especially in a regional role, understanding and respecting cultural nuances and preferences is important for tailoring marketing strategies to specific markets.

Time Management: Effectively prioritizing tasks and managing time to meet deadlines is essential in a fast-paced marketing environment.

Tech-Savviness: Familiarity with marketing technology tools and platforms, as well as proficiency in relevant software and applications, is important for executing marketing initiatives efficiently.

Negotiation Skills: The ability to negotiate and build partnerships with external stakeholders, such as agencies, vendors, and media outlets, can be crucial for successful marketing campaigns.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‐on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‐to‐end reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making;
    ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‐to‐end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services;
    monitor performance anditerate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‐on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.G., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.

Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‐based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E;
    CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning

What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem‐solving skills and a data‐driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‐functional partners and stakeholders.

Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: L3 Support Services Appendix Redhat
description:
L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT

Type: Contract

Location: Columbia/ Argentina/ Brazil (We are only considering candidates from the following countries)

Rate: DOE

Job Summary:

Objective:

Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert.

Key Details:

- Skills: Linux (mandatory) with experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack

- Experience: 7–10 years

- Interview Process: 2 rounds

- Requirements: Immediate

- Candidate has to work in CST OR EST time

Key Responsibilities:

● Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and OpenStack platforms.

● Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations.

● Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, applying strong analytical knowledge to quickly diagnose problems across the entire cloud stack.

● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.

● Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.

● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.

● Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities.

● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs.

● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.

● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Scheduling:

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.'

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:

● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.
